title: Which year recorded the most gas use paid in EUR?
question: Which year recorded the most gas use paid in EUR?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4) AS Year
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Currency = 'EUR'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(T1.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(T1.Price) DESC
LIMIT 1
